args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on Emma Johnson's Hawaii Itinerary (June 10-20, 2024)

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Sunscreen (high SPF, reef-safe recommended)
- Hiking gear (comfortable shoes, light backpack, water bottle)
- Casual outfits (lightweight, breathable clothing)
- Camera or smartphone with waterproof case
- Travel documents (ID, passport if needed, hotel confirmations, flight info)

Additional Recommended Items:
- Beach towel
- Sunglasses and hat
- Light rain jacket (for potential showers)
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel - though can be rented)
- Insect repellent
- Beach bag
- Flip flops/sandals
- Evening attire for the Luau (June 16)
- Reusable water bottle
- Medications and first aid supplies
- Power bank for electronics
- Travel adapter if needed

Activities-Specific Items:
- Waikiki Beach day (June 11): Beach toys, cooler
- Hanauma Bay snorkeling (June 12): Underwater camera
- Diamond Head hiking (June 13): Sturdy hiking shoes, sun protection
- Pearl Harbor visit (June 14): Comfortable walking shoes
- North Shore road trip (June 15): Car essentials, snacks
- Polynesian Cultural Center Luau (June 16): Semi-formal tropical attire
- Hotel spa day (June 17): Spa wear, relaxation items
- Kailua Beach kayaking (June 18): Quick-dry clothing
- Ala Moana Center shopping (June 19): Comfortable shopping shoes
